result.topic_en: Notes on the Riemann–Roch-type count for algebraic functions: the integral of d log(dz/dζ) around the boundary of the cut surface gives the number of branch points w minus twice the number of sheets n, leading to w − 2n = 2p − 2, followed by remarks on functions with m − p + 1 arbitrary constants.
